description: Mobile-browser screenshot (imgoat.com) of a tweet from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump), dated March 1 2019, in which he says the two-year Russian collusion case has fallen apart with no collusion 'except bye Crooked Hillary and the Democrats' and complains investigators will look at his finances and follow 'discredited Michael Cohen.' A red box is drawn around the phrase 'bye Crooked Hillary'. Below the screenshot is the caption 'Love this guy.' The manifest filename is Haiti.png but the image content is unrelated to Haiti.
text: imgoat.com. Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Oh' I see! Now that the 2 year Russian Collusion case has fallen apart, there was no Collusion except bye Crooked Hillary and the Democrats, they say, “gee, I have an idea, let's look at Trump's finances and every deal he has ever done. Let's follow discredited Michael Cohen..... 8:19 AM · 01 Mar 19 · Twitter for iPhone. Back. Forward. Home. Bookmar... Tabs. Love this guy.
flags: Red box highlights 'bye Crooked Hillary' — an apparent typo for 'by' emphasized by the poster
Tweet's claims about the collusion case are the tweet's own assertions

description: Black-and-white photograph in Twitter header-banner proportions (1500x500) showing Hillary Clinton smiling as she leans over a young boy and helps him take a selfie with an iPhone in front of a dark curtain. A woman at far left also holds up a phone. The right third of the frame is blank light-gray space, consistent with a cropped banner image.

description: Screenshot of a Q post (No. 2272925, 07/24/18) on an 8chan-style board that embeds two earlier Q posts. The left quoted post (No. 2007911, Jul 3 2018) quotes a passage about the Five Eyes intelligence-sharing alliance and Devin Nunes saying no intelligence was shared through the official channel that launched the FBI's investigation. The right quoted post (No. 77, 05/10/18) asks why 'former' dignitaries still hold security clearances and claims U.S.-to-New Zealand routing leaves 'No Logs/No Flags/No Records'; that phrase is boxed in red.
